appraisal_events.evidence: son langage, jadis si plein de réserve, [a acquis] une véritable intempérance... il croyait, dans la naïveté de son désir, faire mettre à la retraite... ceux qu'il se faisait fort de remplacer... il s'épanchait avec cette violence sénile de certains octogénaires qui les jette sur des femmes à qui ils ne peuvent plus faire grand mal
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator directly portrays Norpois as having lost his former discretion, indulging in naive political ambitions and senile verbal excess, comparing him to impotent old men venting harmlessly on women; this is a sustained narratorial diminishment of his former stature.

status_effects.explanation: Norpois is locally diminished as the narrator exposes his loss of former reserve, naive political self-importance, and senile garrulousness.
His speech, once marked by diplomatic restraint, is now described as intemperate and vehement outside matters of 'grandes affaires', weakening his rhetorical authority in this passage.
